title: Addressing attribution through contribution analysis: Using performance measures sensibly

container: Evaluating the complex: Attribution, contribution, and beyond (K. Forss, M. Marra and R. Schwartz, Eds.), Transaction Publishers (reissued by Routledge)
note: Chapter 3. Longer treatment for complex settings. Where Mayne said external factors should be shown not to have contributed significantly, a position he withdrew in 2019. Chapter title confirmed in the publisher's contents; page range from Mayne (2019).

title: Contribution analysis: Coming of age?

title: Making causal claims
